title: Renewal-Billing Discount on Northgate Delivery & Installation Old-Appliance Removal
content:
A renewal-billing discount is taken off the surcharged amount once on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment — the removal amount with any percentage added to it. It follows the automatic renewal of the membership presented on the purchase being delivered, as Northgate Memberships records whether that membership renews automatically and the tender its renewal is billed to:

| Presented membership renews automatically | Renewal billed to | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | The Northgate Visa | 20 percent off |
| Yes | Any other tender | 10 percent off |
| No | — | Nothing off |

## Points of judgement

- A membership not on automatic renewal takes nothing off, whatever tender is on file.
- A membership on automatic renewal billed to a tender other than the Northgate Visa takes 10 percent off.

**Hypothetical figure.** A surcharged amount of $45.00 becomes $36.00 with renewal billed to the Northgate Visa, $40.50 with renewal billed to another tender, and stays $45.00 when the membership does not renew automatically.
